dominant_strengths: Editorial serif 'Today' paired with italic date creates a calm, premium tone that elevates an otherwise utilitarian list
Strong information hierarchy: progress ring, rollover banner, Top Priority card, and time-of-day sections guide attention cleanly
Tag color coding (Analytics, Design, Urgent, Engineering) is restrained and functional, supporting scan-ability without noise
dominant_weaknesses: Segmented progress bar competes visually with the 63% ring, duplicating the same metric in two heavy treatments
The 'Top Priority' card feels visually similar in weight to regular tasks — the focus moment isn't dramatic enough
Overdue red and rollover red banner stack near the top, creating an anxious entry rather than a focused one
fix_priorities: Collapse progress ring + segment bar into one canonical progress indicator to reduce redundancy
Amplify Top Priority card with stronger contrast, subtle background, or scale to make focus unmissable
Soften or consolidate the warning/overdue states so the page opens with calm, not alarm
Introduce micro-motion cues (check fill, ring tick) to reward completion behaviorally
rationale.norman_balance: Behaviorally strong with clear task affordances, visceral pleasant via serif typography, but reflective payoff is muted by redundant progress signals and a quiet priority moment.
rationale.intent_fit: Solidly fits a refined task-list brief — the focus block, time partitions, and rollover handling show iteration beyond a baseline list.
